title: NetrunnerEngineCard
description: Card definition as pure data. Effect IR is the executable language; unknown IR nodes fail closed at load time.

requiresProtectingIce.description: Only servers protected by at least one piece of ice are legal run targets (Kompromat).

transferHostedCreditsToEventCredits.description: Move hosted credits on the run source into run eventCredits (Debbie).

addPowerCounterOnSubroutineResolve.description: Place this many power counters on the run source whenever a subroutine resolves during the run (Raindrops Cut Stone).

onRunEnd.description: Effect IR fired when the run ends (success or not), sourced on the run event/ability card.

bypassSecondEncounterForClickIfThreat.description: Threat N → at the second ice encounter this run, Runner may spend [click] to bypass (S-Dobrado).

redirectApproachArchivesToHq.description: After passing Archives ice, change attacked server to HQ and approach HQ (Maintenance Access).

mayRedirectApproachArchivesToHqOrRdPayin.description: After passing Archives ice, Runner may pay this many stealth credits to change attacked server to HQ or R&D and approach that server (Baker).

blockCreditPoolSpendAndLose.description: While this run is active, Runner cannot spend or lose credits from their credit pool (Aircheck).

shredPreventFirstEndTheRun.description: Shred: first Corp end-the-run is prevented unless Corp reveals and trashes X random HQ (X = root size).

skipBreach.description: On successful run, skip breaching the attacked server (e.g. Chastushka replace-breach).

blankAttackedServerRoot.description: During this run, cards in the root of the attacked server lose all abilities (Light the Fire!).

derezProtectingIceOnRunBegin.description: When this run begins, derez 1 ice protecting the attacked server (Window of Opportunity).

mayRezEventDerezzedIceOnRunEndIgnoreCost.description: When this run ends, Corp may rez the ice derezzed by this event, ignoring all costs (Window of Opportunity).

advancementRequirementEqualsRunnerGrip.description: When true, advancement requirement equals the number of cards in the Runner grip (Blood in the Water).

advancementRequirementReductionPerTag.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per Runner tag (Freedom of Information).

advancementRequirementReductionPerCoreDa.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by this many per core damage the Runner has taken this game (Ontological Dependence).

advancementRequirementReductionPerBadPub.description: Reduce this agenda's advancement requirement by per × Corp bad publicity, counting at most max BP (Regulatory Capture).

breaksSubtype.description: Ice subtype to break, or "*" for AI.

breakViaPaidAbilityOnly.description: When true, standard credit break is disabled; breaks only via paidAbilities (e.g. Revolver).

breakMaxSubs.description: Max subroutines per paid break ability use (default 1).

breakCreditsDiscountPerInstalledSubtype.description: Reduce breakCredits by amount × count of installed cards with subtype (Tremolo: cybernetic).

breakRequiresAttackingMark.description: Standard credit break only while attacking the mark (Tunnel Vision).

oncePerTurn.description: Ability usable at most once per turn (Madani install).

creditsFromStealthOnly.description: When true with credits, pay those credits only from hosted credits on stealth cards (Corsair / Lampades / Baker).

rfgSelf.description: Remove this card from the game as a cost (The Back). Engine snapshots hosted counters before RFG.

advancementTokens.description: Spend hosted advancement tokens from this card as a cost (Drago Ivanov).

coreDamage.description: Suffer this much core damage as a cost (Light the Fire!).

tags.description: Take this many tags as a cost (Eru Ayase-Pessoa). Always payable.

removeTags.description: Remove this many Runner tags as a cost (B-1001). Payable only when the Runner has at least that many tags.

creditsPerEncounterSubroutine.description: Pay this many credits per subroutine on the encountered ice (Physarum Entangler).

powerCountersEqualEncounterStrength.description: Spend hosted power counters equal to the effective strength of the ice being encountered (Baklan Bochkin).

trashInstalledProgramUnlessOwnInstalledT.description: Simulchip: trash 1 installed program as an additional cost unless the Runner already trashed an installed card this turn.

requireDuringRun.description: Ability usable only while a run is in progress (Arissana / AirbladeX).

requirePendingDamageTypes.description: Damage interrupt ability legal only while pendingDamage.type is one of these (Plascrete meat; AirbladeX net).

oncePerPendingDamageInstance.description: Damage interrupt: usable at most once per pendingDamage open (Prāna Condenser; CR 9.12.2b).

oncePerEncounter.description: Enforce once-per-encounter usage (Slap Vandal break host).

usableFromHq.description: Corp paid ability usable while this card is in HQ (Expendable; Tree Line).

usableFromArchives.description: Corp paid ability usable while this card is in Archives (Petty Cash).

usableByAnyPlayer.description: Either player may pay and use this ability (Detente).

usableFromRunnerScoreArea.description: Corp paid ability usable while this agenda is in the Runner's score area (Oracle Thinktank).

requiresThreat.description: Ability usable only while Threat N is active (Angelique Garza Correa).

requiresUntagged.description: Ability usable only while the Runner has no tags (Friend of a Friend).

requiresActiveRun.description: Ability usable only while a run is active (Perfect Recall).

requireRunnerTagged.description: Ability usable only while the Runner has at least one tag (Rotary Corp trash).

requiresSuccessfulRdRunThisTurn.description: Ability usable only if the Runner made a successful run on R&D this turn (Cataloguer).

requiresSuccessfulAllCentralsThisTurn.description: Ability usable only if successful runs on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn (The Wizard's Chest).

requireOtherServer.description: Ability usable only during a run against a different server than the one hosting this card (B-1001).

requireEncounterSubtype.description: Encountered ice must have this subtype (e.g. Abagnale bypass).

forbidEncounterSubtype.description: Encountered ice must NOT have this subtype (Physarum).

requireEncounterHost.description: Encountered ice must be this card's host (Physarum / trojans).

requireEncounterStrengthLte.description: Encountered ice strength must be ≤ this value (Malandragem).

requireEncounterChosenIce.description: Encountered ice must be the ice chosen on install (Boomerang; chosenIceId).

requireProtectingHostServer.description: Encountered ice must protect the same server as the ice hosting this card (Living Mural).

requireAttackingMark.description: Ability usable only while attacking the designated mark (e.g. Backstitching).

requiresCorpCreditsGte.description: Ability usable only while the Corp has at least this many credits (Fransofia Ward).

hostStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify host ice strength by this amount (Monkeywrench).

hostStrengthPerVirusCounter.description: While hosted on ice, modify host ice strength by this amount per virus counter on this card (Chisel: -1).

onHostEncounter.description: Effect IR when the Runner encounters the ice hosting this card (Chisel).

rezAsNonIceDuringRunsOnServer.description: During runs against this ice's server, may rez this ice any time non-ice cards could be rezzed (Rime).

sameServerIceStrengthBonus.description: While rezzed, each ice protecting the same server gets this much strength (Rime: +1).

hostIcebreakerStrengthBonus.description: While this hardware is hosted on an icebreaker, that breaker gets +strength (GAMEDRAGON Pro).

extendsHostBreakerPumpToRun.description: While hosted on an icebreaker, that breaker's strength pumps last for the run (GAMEDRAGON Pro).

otherIceProtectingServerStrengthModifier.description: While hosted on ice, modify strength of each other ice protecting the same server (Monkeywrench).

onBypass.description: Effect IR when the Runner bypasses a piece of ice (Capybara).

onBypassMayInstallFromHeap.description: While in the heap, Threat N → may spend clickCost to install this card when the Runner bypasses ice (Jeitinho).

daemonHost.description: Daemon that can host installed non-daemon programs; hosted programs do not count toward used MU (Muse).

onFirstProgramInstallEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner installs a program (LilyPAD).

onFirstHardwareInstallEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner installs a piece of hardware (Masterwork v37).

onFirstEncounterEachRun.description: Effect IR the first time each run the Runner encounters a piece of ice (Baklan Bochkin).

onFirstCorpCardTrashEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner trashes a Corp card (Solidarity Badge).

onAccessTrash.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner trashes a card they are accessing (Audrey v2).

onFirstCorpRootInstallEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Corp installs a card in a server root (Lago Paranoá Shelter).

onAccessRequiresRezzed.description: When true, onAccess fires only while this card is rezzed (Angelique Garza Correa).

onPassHost.description: Effect IR when the Runner passes the ice hosting this card (Pichação).

hostedCreditsOnAnyIceRez.description: Place this many hosted credits when any ice is rezzed (Cybersand Harvester).

hostedCreditsSpendFor.description: Spend non-recurring hosted credits for these purposes (Cybersand install; Bahia Bands trash; Mystic Maemi play_event).

iceRezCostReductionProtectingThisServer.description: While rezzed, lower rez cost of each ice protecting this server by this many credits (Vovô Ozetti).

rootRezCostReductionThisServerIfThreat.description: Threat N → while rezzed, lower rez cost of each card in this server's root by amount (Vovô Ozetti).

onCorpTurnEnd.description: Effect IR when the Corp's turn ends while this card is rezzed (Vovô Ozetti may-move).

rezAdditionalCost.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when rezzing this card (Valentão).

onHostRezzed.description: Effect IR when host ice is rezzed (Saci).

onHostDerezzed.description: Effect IR when host ice is derezzed (Saci).

onScore.description: Effect IR evaluated when Corp scores this agenda.

onForfeit.description: Effect IR evaluated when Corp forfeits this scored agenda (Greenmail).

scoreAdditionalCost.description: Additional cost Effect IR paid before scoring this agenda (e.g. Azef Protocol must trash 1 other installed Corp card).

stealAdditionalCost.description: Additional cost Effect IR paid before stealing this agenda (e.g. SDS Drone Deployment must trash 1 installed program).

onSteal.description: Effect IR evaluated when Runner steals this agenda.

onStealAgenda.description: Effect IR on an installed Runner card whenever the Runner steals an agenda (Mystic Maemi / Paladin Poemu).

onEncounter.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner encounters this ice.

onPass.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner passes this ice (Phoneutria).

threatCannotSpendCreditsDuringSubs.description: Threat N → Runner cannot spend credits while subroutines on this ice are resolving (Attini).

onApproachServer.description: Effect IR evaluated when the Runner approaches the server this card protects (rezzed upgrade/asset in root; e.g. Nanisivik Grid).

remoteOnly.description: Corp may only install this card in a remote server (e.g. ZATO City Grid).

iceGainsTrashToResolveChosenSubOnEncount.description: While rezzed: each ice protecting this server gains encounter ability — choose 1 subroutine; may trash the ice to resolve it (ZATO City Grid).

firstEncounterSubsBecomeNetDamage.description: While installed: during the first encounter each turn with ice protecting the server named via may_choose_server / namedServerId, each subroutine resolves as Do N net damage instead (Tsakhia Bankhar Gantulga).

trashWhenNoHostedCards.description: When this card has no hosted cards remaining, trash it (Asmund Pudlat).

onTurnBegin.description: Effect IR evaluated when this card's controller's turn begins (rezzed/installed, or Runner/Corp identity).

onInstall.description: Effect IR evaluated when this card is installed.

onSuccessfulRun.description: Effect IR when the Runner makes a successful run while this card is installed, is the Runner identity, or is an active lockdown in corp:play-area (Argus Crackdown / Hyoubu Precog Manifold).

onSuccessfulRunOncePerTurn.description: When true, onSuccessfulRun fires at most once per turn for this instance (e.g. first successful run on the mark).

onAccess.description: Effect IR when this card is accessed (ambushes).

mustRevealWhenAccessedFromRd.description: Static ability: while accessing this card in R&D, the Runner must reveal it (CR §1.21.7).

skipOnAccessFromArchives.description: When true, onAccess does not fire if this card is accessed from Archives (Snare!, Behold!).

onFirstTagThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner is tagged each turn (identities).

onTakeTagsWhenUntagged.description: Runner identity: Effect IR when taking 1+ tags while previously untagged (Sebastião).

connectionBasicTrashAdditionalCostTrashH.description: As additional cost for Corp basic trash of a connection resource, trash 1 from HQ (Sebastião).

onEncounterEndIfRezzedThisTurn.description: Effect IR when an encounter with this ice ends if it was rezzed this turn (Cloud Eater).

onAfterOperationOrExpendable.description: Corp identity: Effect IR after resolving an operation or expendable card action (Nuvem).

creditsOnFirstRdTrashThisTurn.description: Corp identity: gain N¢ the first time each turn a card is trashed from R&D (Nuvem).

onFirstPassRezzedCodeGateOrSentryThisTur.description: Scored agenda: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner passes a rezzed code gate or sentry (Sisyphus).

onRunBeginMaySpendAgendaCounterRezUpToIc.description: Scored: on run begin may spend agenda counter to rez up to N ice protecting attacked (Lightning Laboratory).

onCorpTurnEndDerezUpToIceProtectingLight.description: Scored: Corp turn end derez up to N ice protecting Lightning's remembered server.

oncePerTurnOnRezIceProtectingThisServerD.description: Brasília: once/turn when ice rezzed protecting this server during a run, may derez another for +N strength.

onRezApOrDestroyerIceDuringRun.description: Thunderbolt: when rez AP/destroyer ice during a run, +strength and grant ETR-unless-trash sub.

derezAtAnyTurnEnd.description: While rezzed, derez this card when any turn ends (Lycian Multi-Munition).

onFirstCoreDamageThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner suffers core damage each turn (Runner identities; CR §10.4.2b).

onFirstRdRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner begins a run on R&D each turn (Runner identities; e.g. Padma may charge).

onFirstArchivesRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn a run on Archives begins while this card is rezzed (Front Company).

rezOnlyDuringCorpTurn.description: May only rez this card during the Corp's turn (Front Company).

firstRunCannotTargetRemote.description: While rezzed, the first run each turn cannot target a remote server (Front Company).

persistent.description: Abilities remain active while installed even if unrezzed (Tucana / Daniela).

trashAdditionalCost.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when the Runner trashes this card (Daniela).

stealAdditionalCostFromProtectingServer.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when the Runner steals an agenda from this server (Daniela Persistent).

stealAdditionalClicks.description: Additional clicks the Runner must spend to steal this agenda (Méliès City Luxury Line).

stealAdditionalCredits.description: Additional credits the Runner must pay to steal this agenda (Bellona).

stealAdditionalCreditsWhileRezzed.description: While this card is rezzed, Runner must pay this many credits as an additional cost to steal any agenda (Magistrate Revontulet).

runnerLoseCreditsOnBreakPrintedSubroutin.description: Whenever the Runner breaks a printed subroutine on this ice, they lose this many credits (Gold Farmer).

playCostDiscountPerIceProtectingServer.description: Reduce this card's play cost by 1 for each piece of ice protecting the named server (Tailgate).

maxRemoteServers.description: Corp identity: maximum number of remote servers (A Teia / Earth Station).

hqUnflipped.description: Additional credits to initiate a run on HQ while identity is unflipped (Earth Station).

remoteFlipped.description: Additional credits to initiate a run on a remote while identity is flipped (Earth Station).

additionalRunInitiateCredits.description: Corp identity: additional credit cost to initiate a run, gated by face (Earth Station; CR 1.16.1b / 4.6.8f).

vacheronStealReplacement.description: When this agenda would be added to the Runner score area from anywhere except Archives, instead add it with 4 agenda counters (Project Vacheron; CR 9.9.9c). Replacement does not re-trigger on its own result.

worthZeroAgendaPointsWhileHasAgendaCount.description: While in the Runner score area with ≥1 agenda counters, contribute 0 agenda points (Project Vacheron).

onFirstHardwareUseDuringRunEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner uses (resolves a paid ability on) installed hardware during a run while this card is installed (The Back).

onCorpAbilityCausesRunnerSpendOrLoseCred.description: Corp identity: Effect IR whenever a Corp card ability causes the Runner to spend or lose ≥1¢ during a run — once per aggregate payment/lose instruction (GameNET; CR 1.16.2b).

onFirstRemoteInstallThisTurn.description: Identity: Effect IR the first time each turn Corp installs on a remote root or protecting ice (A Teia).

onFirstRunBeginThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn a run begins while this card is scored or installed (Stegodon / Knickknack / Prognostic Q-Loop).

onRunBegin.description: Effect IR whenever a run begins while this card is installed or an active lockdown in corp:play-area (Side Hustle / SYNC Rerouting).

onDiscardPhaseEnd.description: Effect IR when the owner's discard phase ends (Corp: Project Ingatan / Embedded Reporting / Sericulture / PT Untaian / Off the Books; Runner: Lat Ethical Freelancer).

onCorpActionPhaseEnd.description: Effect IR when the Corp's action phase ends (Corp identity, rezzed root, or scored agenda; Mercia / Nebula / Witch Hunt).

onApproachIce.description: Effect IR when the Runner approaches ice protecting this server (rezzed upgrade in root; Mitra Aman).

identityFlippedHooks.description: Corp dual/multi-faced identity: effects while flipped (Nebula / Méliès U).

onFirstOperationPlayThisTurn.description: First operation played each turn while flipped.

onSuccessfulHqOrRdRun.description: Successful Runner run on HQ or R&D while flipped.

onSuccessfulHqRun.description: Successful Runner run on HQ while flipped (Earth Station unflip).

onFlipToBackIfRunMatchesFace.description: When flipping to back during a run on the secretly-set central (Méliès U).

onRunnerDiscardPhaseEnd.description: When the Runner's discard phase ends while flipped (Méliès U).

onRunnerDiscardOverMaxHand.description: Runner identity: Effect IR after discarding to max hand size, with discarded batch available (Magdalene).

onRunnerActionPhaseEnd.description: Effect IR when the Runner's action phase ends while this card is installed (Cacophony).

onAnyIceRez.description: Runner identity: whenever Corp rezzes ice (Barry Wong).

serverRootAssetTrashCostBonus.description: Mahkota: +N trash cost for assets in this server's root.

playRequiresNoCorpActionFinished.description: Corp operation: play only before the first Corp action completes (Petty Cash).

playRequiresNoActiveLockdown.description: Corp lockdown operation: play only if no lockdown is active in corp:play-area (CR §3.5.1c / SYNC Rerouting et al.).

lingerUntilCorpNextTurnBegins.description: Corp lockdown: after play, remain faceup in corp:play-area (not trashed to Archives) until Corp's next turn begins; trash at that turn-begin checkpoint before pending conditionals (CR §8.6.6c / §3.5.1c).

base.description: Flat additional credits to steal any agenda while this card is active.

perAdvancement.description: Additional credits per advancement counter on the stolen agenda.

stealAdditionalCreditsFormula.description: While this lockdown is active, Runner pays base + perAdvancement×advancementTokens as an additional cost to steal an agenda (NAPD Cordon).

allIceStrengthBonus.description: While this card is active (installed or lingering lockdown), each piece of ice gets +N strength (NEXT Activation Command; inverse of allIceStrengthPenalty).

cannotBreakExceptIcebreaker.description: While this card is active, Runner cannot break subroutines using cards that lack the icebreaker subtype (NEXT Activation Command; covers non-breaker paid breaks).

onCreditsGainedFromAgendaOrOperationAbil.description: Corp identity: first time each turn credits are gained via an agenda or operation ability (Zwicky).

onFirstAgendaScoredOrStolenThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn an agenda is scored or stolen while this card is rezzed (Phật Gioan Baotixita).

rezCostCreditDiscountOnForfeitAgenda.description: Optional: forfeit 1 agenda when rezzing to reduce rez cost by this many credits (Biawak).

amount.description: Fire when hosted credits reach this many or more.

effect.description: Effect IR evaluated when the threshold is met.

onHostedCreditsGte.description: Static-condition ability when hosted credits ≥ amount (Side Hustle).

whileScoredBreakerStrengthPenaltyIfIceDe.description: While scored, if any ice was derezzed this run, each icebreaker gets -N strength (Stegodon).

onFirstVirusInstallThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time the Runner installs a virus program each turn (installed continuous; e.g. Avgustina sabotage).

onFirstSuccessfulMarkRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on their mark (installed continuous / identity; e.g. Virtuoso HQ bonus access or post-run HQ breach).

onFirstSuccessfulHqRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on HQ (installed continuous; e.g. PAN-Weave Corp loses 1¢ / Runner gains 1¢ if they do).

onFirstSuccessfulCentralRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on a central server (HQ / R&D / Archives; installed continuous; e.g. Zenit Chip draw 1).

onFirstSuccessfulRunThisTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner makes a successful run on any server (e.g. Pravdivost may place 1 advancement).

onProgramOrHardwareInstall.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs a program or piece of hardware (installed continuous; e.g. Environmental Testing place 1 power counter).

amount.description: Fire when hosted power counters reach this many or more.

effect.description: Effect IR evaluated when the threshold is met (e.g. trash self + gain credits).

onPowerCountersGte.description: Static-condition ability when hosted power counters ≥ amount (e.g. Environmental Testing trash + gain 9¢).

onAgendaScored.description: Effect IR when Corp scores any agenda (identity or installed continuous).

onAgendaScoredOrStolen.description: Effect IR when any agenda is scored or stolen (installed continuous, e.g. Daeg).

onAgendaStolen.description: Effect IR when the Runner steals an agenda (Corp identity, e.g. Thule Subsea).

onFullyBreakOncePerTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn this program fully breaks a piece of ice (Orca, Abaasy).

gainCreditsOnFirstMarkRunEndIfBreached.description: Gain this many credits the first time each turn a run on your mark ends if you breached (Info Bounty).

gainCreditsOnFirstCompanionInstallOrSpen.description: Gain this many credits the first time each turn you install a companion or spend credits from an installed companion (Keiko).

bioroidBreakGivesCorpAllottedClickNextTu.description: When the Runner spends a click to break a subroutine on this bioroid ice, Corp gets +1 allotted click for their next turn (Týr).

paidAbilitiesUseStealthCreditsOnly.description: Spend credits only from stealth cards to use paid abilities / credit costs on this card (Mu Safecracker).

onSuccessfulHqRunMayPayForBonusAccess.description: On successful HQ run, may pay credits for bonusAccess on the upcoming breach (Mu Safecracker).

onSuccessfulRdRunMayPayForBonusAccess.description: On successful R&D run, may pay credits for bonusAccess on the upcoming breach (Mu Safecracker).

meatDamageOnInstalledCorpTrashOncePerTur.description: Do this much meat damage the first time each turn the Runner trashes an installed Corp card (Hostile Architecture).

maySpendPowerCountersForBonusRdAccess.description: When breaching R&D, may remove up to max hosted power counters for that many bonus accesses (Wake Implant).

powerOnScoreIfAgendaNotInstalledOrAdvanc.description: When scoring an agenda not installed or advanced this turn, place 1 power counter (Issuaq Adaptics).

agendaPointsToWinReductionPerPowerCounte.description: Reduce agenda points needed to win by this amount per hosted power counter (Issuaq Adaptics).

creditsOnTrashFromThisServer.description: Gain this many credits when a card is trashed from this server's root or ice, except during install (Yakov).

blanksHostAbilities.description: While hosted on ice, host loses abilities except printed subroutines (Hush).

chargeOnFirstBreakDuringHostEncounter.description: First break during an encounter with host ice: may charge (Flux Capacitor).

hostedCreditsOnInstall.description: Credits placed on this card when installed (e.g. Armitage).

strengthBonusProtectingRemote.description: Printed strength bonus while protecting a remote server.

strengthBonusProtectingArchives.description: Printed strength bonus while protecting Archives (Bathynomus).

strengthBonusWhileTagged.description: Printed strength bonus while the Runner is tagged (Capacitor).

handSizeBonus.description: Modifier to controller max hand size while installed/scored.

allottedClicksBonus.description: Modifier to allotted clicks each of the controller's turns while installed (Basilar Synthgland).

excludeSubtype.description: Do not grant the bonus to icebreakers with this subtype (K2CP Turbine: ai).

giveStrengthToInstalledIcebreakers.description: Aura: each other installed icebreaker gets +amount strength (K2CP Turbine).

rfgOnUninstall.description: When this card is uninstalled from the rig, remove it from the game instead of trashing to heap (Nanuq).

memoryCost.description: Memory units used by this program (default 1).

muBonus.description: Bonus to Runner memory limit while installed.

corpCardTrashCostReduction.description: While installed: lower the trash cost of each Corp card by this many credits (Demolisher). Floored at 0.

strengthBonusPerHeapSubtype.description: Strength bonus per card of subtype in the heap (Rising Tide).

installCostDiscountPerInstalledIcebreake.description: Reduce install cost by this × currently installed icebreakers (Principia).

strengthBonusPerCoreDamageThisGame.description: Strength bonus per core damage the Runner has taken this game (Begemot).

threatStrengthBonus.description: Threat N → adjust this card's strength by amount while threat is active (Shibboleth).

firstJobConnectionOrHardwareInstallDisco.description: The first job resource, connection resource, or piece of hardware installed each turn costs this many credits less (Az McCaffrey).

amplifyNetDamageOnTrashChosenEncounterTy.description: During an encounter after choose_card_type_for_encounter: whenever net damage from a subroutine on this ice trashes a card of the chosen type, do 1 net damage (Saisentan).

onOtherAgendaStolen.description: Effect IR on a scored Corp agenda whenever the Runner steals another agenda (Divested Trust).

spendHostedCreditsToUseProgramsDuringRun.description: Hosted credits on this card may be spent to use programs during runs (Trickster Taka).

playRequiresFirstClick.description: Play only as the Runner's first click this turn (priority; In the Groove; CR 1.11.4).

effect.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs a card meeting the threshold for the remainder of this turn (In the Groove; CR 9.6.13b).

remainderOfTurnOnInstallPrintedCostGte.description: Delayed conditional for the remainder of this turn on install with printed install cost ≥ min (In the Groove).

clicksOnHostedEmpty.description: When hosted credits empty and card trashes, gain this many clicks (Otto Campaign).

playRequiresInstalledResource.description: Play only if the Runner has at least one installed resource (Sell Out).

playRequiresInstalledProgram.description: Play only if the Runner has at least one installed program (Spec Work).

playRequiresInstalledProgramOrHardware.description: Play only if the Runner has at least one installed program or piece of hardware (Rejig).

playRequiresUntagged.description: Play only if the Runner has no tags (Eye for an Eye / Privileged Access).

playRequiresMinTags.description: Play only if the Runner has at least this many tags (Shipment from Vladisibirsk).

rezAdditionalCostDerezSubtype.description: As an additional rez cost, derez another rezzed ice with this subtype (Bloop / harmonic).

handSizePerPowerCounter.description: Runner max hand size +N per hosted power counter (Hippocampic Mechanocytes).

runnerHandSizePenaltyPerPowerCounter.description: While rezzed: Runner max hand size −N per hosted power counter (Dr. Vientiane Keeling).

installRequiresSuccessfulCentralRunThisT.description: Install only if Runner made a successful run on a central this turn (Time Bomb).

coreDamageOnAgendaScoredFromThisServer.description: When Corp scores an agenda from this server's root, do this much core damage (Djupstad Grid).

playRequiresAgendaStolenThisTurn.description: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda this turn (Reprise).

runEventOptional.description: When true with runEvent, playing without a server skips the run (Reprise may-run).

playRequiresAgendaStolenLastTurn.description: Play only if the Runner stole an agenda during their last turn (Distributed Tracing).

playRequiresRunnerStoleOrTrashedCorpCard.description: Play only if the Runner stole or trashed a Corp card during their last turn (Oppo Research).

onFirstRunnerStoleOrTrashedCorpCardThisT.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner steals or trashes a Corp card (Epiphany identity; Cacophony resource).

wageWorkersTrackActions.description: While rezzed, after each Corp action of a type taken exactly 3 times this turn, gain 1 click (Wage Workers).

playRequiresNoSuccessfulHqRunLastTurn.description: Corp operation: play only if the Runner did not make a successful run on HQ during their last turn (Digital Rights Management).

playRequiresThreat.description: Play only while Threat N is active (Measured Response).

cannotBeTrashedByRunnerWhileRezzed.description: While rezzed, the Runner cannot trash this card (Kessleroid).

cannotBreakExceptSubtype.description: Printed subroutines on this ice can only be broken by icebreakers with this subtype (Semak-samun / fracter).

strengthBonusIfSoleIceProtectingServer.description: While this is the only ice protecting its server, it gets +N strength (Scatter Field).

paidAbilityCreditDiscountIfRunEventActiv.description: Reduce paid ability credit costs by this amount while a run event is active (Sang Kancil).

threatGiveTagsOnRezzedTrash.description: Threat N → when the Runner trashes this card while rezzed, give that many tags (Public Access Plaza).

hostedCreditsSpendForInstallSubtypes.description: When set with hostedCreditsSpendFor install, hosted credits apply only to resources with these subtypes (Open Market).

hostedCreditsSpendForInstallExcludeSubty.description: When set with hostedCreditsSpendFor install, hosted credits cannot be spent to install cards with these subtypes (Paladin Poemu excludes connection).

accessTrashSelfNonAgendaThenDraw.description: Access → trash this card to trash the accessed non-agenda Corp card, then draw 1 (Gourmand).

unsupported.description: Explicit notes for clauses not implemented in the engine/IR yet.

nrdbCode.description: Optional NetrunnerDB code — metadata only, not behavior.

strengthPerVirusCounter.description: Ice strength modifier per hosted virus counter (Sandstone: -1).

iceRezCostIncreaseBySubtype.description: While installed, increase rez cost of ice with this subtype by amount credits (CR §1.16.2a / §8.1.2d; e.g. Cat's Cradle code-gate-only).

rezCostDiscountPerRezzedSubtype.description: When rezzing this ice, reduce rez cost by amount per already-rezzed ice with this subtype (CR §1.16.2a / §8.1.2d; e.g. Ivik −1¢ per rezzed code gate).

rezCostDiscountPerOtherUnrezzedIce.description: When rezzing this ice, reduce rez cost by this many credits per other unrezzed piece of ice (CR §1.16.2a / §8.1.2d; e.g. Reverb −1¢ per other unrezzed ice).

eventPlayCostDiscount.description: While installed, lower the play cost of each event by this many credits (CR §1.16.2a; e.g. Ghosttongue).

cannotScoreIfInstalledThisTurn.description: This agenda cannot be scored if it was installed this turn (Vulnerability Audit). Self-only — unlike Clot's forbidScoreAgendaInstalledThisTurn.

rfgWhenPowerEmpty.description: When hosted power counters reach 0, remove this card from the game (Malandragem).

badPublicityCountersOnRez.description: Load this many hosted bad publicity counters when this card is rezzed (Superdeep Borehole). Hosted BP is not player BP until taken.

winWhenBadPublicityCountersEmpty.description: While rezzed, when hosted bad publicity counters reach 0 the Corp wins (Superdeep Borehole).

playRequiresSuccessfulHqRunThisTurn.description: Play only if the Runner made a successful run on HQ this turn (e.g. Emergency Shutdown).

playRequiresSuccessfulAllCentralsThisTur.description: Play only if successful runs on HQ, R&D, and Archives this turn (Deep Dive).

playRequiresScoredAgendaNotInstalledThis.description: Play only if Corp scored an agenda this turn that was not installed this turn (Myōshu).

firstDoubleOperationClickDiscount.description: While rezzed, the first double operation each turn costs this many clicks less to play (Synchrocyclotron).

rezCostDiscountIfAgendaScoredOrStolenThi.description: While an agenda was scored or stolen this turn, reduce this card's rez cost by this amount (Hype Machine).

onEncounterEnd.description: Effect IR when an encounter with this ice ends (Knowledge Seeker).

allIceStrengthPenalty.description: While installed, each piece of ice gets −N strength (The Tungsten Tailor). See also allIceStrengthBonus for lockdown +N.

gainCreditOnBreakIceStrengthLteOncePerTu.description: First time each turn you break a subroutine on ice with effective strength ≤ this value, gain 1¢ (The Tungsten Tailor; typically 0).

onHardwareInstallOrTrash.description: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs or trashes hardware from any location (Hiram 0mission).

installServers.description: Upgrade/agenda may only be installed on these central servers (The Red Room / Flagship).

playAdditionalClicks.description: Extra clicks beyond the first when playing (triples = 2). Overrides playAdditionalClick count.

etrSubroutinesPerPowerCounter.description: Ice gains an ETR subroutine before printed ones per hosted power counter (Envelopment).

powerCounterOnHarmonicIceRez.description: When any harmonic ice is rezzed, place 1 power counter on this ice (Echo).

powerOnFirstInstalledCardCreditSpendThis.description: First spend of credits from an installed card each turn places 1 power (The Twinning).

removePowerForBonusAccessOnHqRdBreach.description: On HQ/R&D breach, remove up to this many power for bonus accesses (The Twinning).

onTrash.description: Effect IR when this Corp card is trashed to Archives (Mavirus).

onTrashFromGripOrStack.description: Effect IR when this Runner card is trashed from grip or stack (Steelskin).

onRezzedCardTrashed.description: Identity: when a rezzed Corp card is trashed not during install (Ob Superheavy).

endsActionPhase.description: Terminal: end the action phase after resolving this operation (Big Deal).

playAdditionalCost.description: Effect IR paid as an additional cost when playing this event/operation (e.g. Running Hot suffer core damage).

interfaceRequiresTrojanHost.description: Can only interface with ice hosting a trojan program (Umbrella).

onFullyBreak.description: Effect IR whenever this card fully breaks a piece of ice (Curupira; unbounded).

hostedCreditsOnRunEventPlay.description: Place this many hosted credits whenever the Runner plays a run event (Debbie).

hostedCreditsOnFirstEventPlayOncePerTurn.description: First time each turn the Runner plays an event, place this many hosted credits (Touchstone).

spendHostedCreditsDuringRuns.description: Hosted credits on this card may be spent during runs (Touchstone / stealth pools).

accessTrashPayingPrintedCostFromStealth.description: Access → spend 1 hosted power counter and pay the accessed card's printed rez or play cost from stealth credits to trash it (Lampades).

maxAccessOtherThanSelf.description: While rezzed, Runner may access at most this many cards other than this upgrade during a run against its server (Flagship).

firstEncounterGainsSubroutine.description: First encounter each turn, ice gains this subroutine before printed ones for the encounter (Stick and Poke).

mayTakeTagForBonusAccessOnHqRdBreach.description: On HQ/R&D breach, may take 1 tag to access this many additional cards (Rotary).

maySwapOutermostIceOnPassAfterFullyBreak.description: Once per turn when passing outermost ice after fully breaking it, may swap with another installed ice (Sipa).

creditsOnFirstAdvanceThisTurn.description: First time each turn this card is advanced, gain this many credits (Sacrifice Zone Expansion).

onSuccessfulRunOtherServerOncePerTurn.description: Once per turn when the Runner makes a successful run on another server, evaluate this effect (Sacrifice Zone Expansion).

onSpendCreditsOutsidePoolDuringRunOncePe.description: Once per turn when the Runner spends credits from outside their credit pool during a run against this server, evaluate this effect (Shackleton Grid).

onBreachHqRdIfNoBreaksOncePerTurnMayBonu.description: Once per turn when breaching HQ/R&D with no breaks this run, may access this many additional cards (Mercury).

min.description: Minimum R&D cards already allowed this breach before the may-bonus fires.

onBreachRdIfAccessGteMayBonusAccess.description: Pretty Mary: when breaching R&D, if allowed R&D access ≥ min, may access amount additional cards.

onRemoveTags.description: Effect IR whenever 1 or more tags are removed while this card is installed (Valentina).

onRunnerTurnEnd.description: Effect IR at the end of the Runner's turn while this card is installed or is the Runner identity (Amanuensis / Hoshiko Shiro).

onFirstGripOrStackTrashBatchEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn 1 or more cards are trashed from the Runner's grip or stack while this card is installed (Buffer Drive). Engine supplies the trashed batch card ids when evaluating may_add_one_of_card_ids_to_stack_bottom.

onFirstResourcePaidAbilityEachTurn.description: Effect IR the first time each turn the Runner resolves a paid ability on an installed resource (Juli Moreira Lee). Sourced on this card.

advancedIceProtectingThisServerStrengthB.description: Each advanced ice protecting this server gets +N strength (Isaac Liberdade).

onMovedToServerRoot.description: Effect IR whenever this upgrade finishes moving to a server root (Isaac Liberdade).

powerOnHqRdRunEndIfAccessedGte.description: On HQ/R&D run end, if accessed ≥ min cards, place amount power (Amelia Earhart).

bonusAccessOnHqRdBreachWhileTagged.description: While tagged, +N card access when breaching HQ or R&D (Manuel Lattes de Moura).

bonusAccessOnFirstHqBreachThisTurn.description: The first time each turn you breach HQ, access +N additional cards (Docklands Pass; CR §7.4.2).

preventFirstTagThisTurn.description: The first time each turn you would take a tag, prevent 1 tag (Jesminder-class; also blocks nested tag costs per CR §1.16.1b).

threatBasicTrashAdditionalCostTrashHq.description: Threat N → as additional cost for Corp basic trash of this resource, trash 1 from HQ (Manuel).

powerCounterOnAnyCardRez.description: Place this many power counters whenever any card is rezzed, including this one (Working Prototype).

powerCountersOnPlay.description: Place this many power counters when this event is played (Spree).

chooseIceOnInstall.description: When installed, choose 1 installed ice and store chosenIceId; use only vs that ice (Boomerang; no bypass).

onInstallFromNonHq.description: Effect IR when this card is installed from anywhere except HQ (Stoke the Embers).

paidAbilityCreditDiscountIfOwnInstalledT.description: Reduce paid ability credit costs by this amount if the Runner trashed any of their installed cards this turn (Boi-tatá).

maxInstalledRunnerTrashesPerEncounter.description: This ice cannot trash more than N installed Runner cards during each encounter (Sorocaban Blade).

maxPrintedSubsBreakExceptSubtype.description: Breakers with this subtype ignore maxPrintedSubsBreakablePerEncounter (Hammer killers).

maxHostedCards.description: Limit on faceup hosted cards (not installed) on this program (Cupellation).

accessHostNonAgendaFaceup.description: Access → pay creditCost to host the non-agenda card being accessed faceup on this program; if it was installed, it becomes uninstalled (Cupellation).

onBreachHqIfHostingCorpCard.description: Effect IR when breaching HQ while this program hosts a Corp card (Cupellation may pay+trash for bonus access).

onWouldAccessArchivesHostInstead.description: Interrupt: whenever you would access a card in Archives, may host it faceup on this program instead (not installed). oncePerArchivesBreach limits to one use per Archives breach (Heliamphora).

onVirusPurge.description: Effect IR when the Corp purges virus counters (Heliamphora: trash 2 random HQ then trash self). Prefer over trashOnVirusPurge when purge does more than trash this card.

shredPreventFirstEndTheRun.description: Shred: the first time the Corp would end that run, prevent unless Corp reveals and trashes X random HQ (X = root size of attacked server).

hostedCardsPlayableAsGrip.description: Bling: play or install hosted cards as if they were in the grip.

onInstallWithoutSpendingCredits.description: Bling: Effect IR whenever the Runner installs a card without spending credits.

usableByAnyPlayer.description: Paid ability: either player may pay and use (Detente).

hostStrengthIncreasesLastForRun.description: Gamedragon Pro: while this is hosted on an icebreaker, strength increases on the host last for the remainder of the run.

powerCounterOnDamageOrTrashFromHq.description: Au Co: whenever Corp does damage or trashes ≥1 from HQ, place 1 power on this identity.

mayInstallAgendasFaceup.description: Bangun: Corp may install agendas faceup (abilities inactive until scored).

onAccessFaceupInstalledAgenda.description: Bangun: Effect IR when the Runner accesses a faceup installed agenda.

returnHostedBadPublicityOnUninstall.description: When this card would be uninstalled, take all hosted bad publicity (Luana Campos).

agendaPointsModifierInRunnerScoreArea.description: Modify agenda points while in the Runner score area (Let Them Dream −1).

onFirstBadPublicityTakeEachTurn.description: First time each turn Corp takes bad publicity, evaluate this effect (Editorial Division).

onArchivesFacedownTurnedFaceupGte.description: When ≥min facedown Archives cards are turned faceup together, evaluate effect (Nurse Hạnh).

powerCounterOnAgendaScoredOrStolenFromTh.description: Place this many power counters when an agenda is scored or stolen from this server (Perfect Recall).

powerCountersOnRez.description: Load power counters when rezzed (Perfect Recall).

unique.description: Card is unique (♦) per NRDB uniqueness.

additionalCostOnScoreAgendaInstalledThis.description: Runner: Effect IR additional cost when Corp scores an agenda installed this turn (Word on the Street).

hostsUniqueCompanionOrConnectionResource.description: Location may host unique companion/connection resources at a credit discount (Hackerspace).

handSizeBonusIfHostingCompanionAndConnec.description: While hosting both a companion and a connection, Runner max hand size +N (Hackerspace).

flipIdentityOnSuccessfulCentralRun.description: Corp identity flips on successful Runner run on a central server (Méliès U).

approachServerEtrUnlessCreditsPerAdvance.description: Cayambe Grid: ETR unless Runner pays N credits per advanced protecting ice.

onVirusPurgeOncePerTurn.description: Cyberdex Sandbox: onVirusPurge fires at most once per turn.

gainClickOnFirstRunEventThisTurn.description: Swift: gain [click] the first time each turn a run event is played.

playRequiresOtherGripCardsGte.description: Moshing: require at least this many other grip cards (trash additional cost).

onFirstEventTrashedThisTurn.description: Aniccam: effect on first event trashed each turn

onFirstInstallInThisServerRootThisTurn.description: Tranquility: first install in this server root
